description: This PHP source file defines the 'TrackerQueriesDatabaseStore' class which implements data storage and update logic for tracking query-related metrics within the SuiteCRM system. It interacts with database management components to update or insert tracking data based on monitoring information.

classes.name: TrackerQueriesDatabaseStore
classes.description: A class responsible for persisting tracker query metrics into the database, updating existing records or inserting new ones based on monitoring data.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Persists monitoring data to the database; updates existing records if run_count > 1, otherwise inserts new records with metrics.
